Stated Claim / Post Context:
Trump scales back public appearances after CIA and Mossad intercept plans for Iranian drone attack... as the line of succession is shuffled away to secure locations

The report comes as the President has failed to make a public appearance since Wednesday after a constant stream of public rallies ahead of the midterm elections.

Actual Article Body:
By STEPHEN M. LEPORE, US SENIOR REPORTER

Published:  11:19 AEDT, 15 November 2026   |  Updated:  15:48 AEDT, 15 November 2026

The CIA has reportedly been warned by Mossad that Iran has plotted to assassinate Donald Trump using explosive drones.

The report comes as the President has failed to make a public appearance since Wednesday after a constant stream of public rallies ahead of the midterm elections.

Israeli newspaper Israel Hayom claims that Mossad provided intelligence to the CIA claiming Iran is going to target Trump, months after fears of an assassination plot forced the President to switch planes.

Mossad head Roman Gofman has been in talks with CIA Director John Ratcliffe this past week in Washington.

Senior Israeli and US officials have said that the plots have cooled down peace talks between DC and Iran in recent days.

A senior official said that Israeli intelligence claims the plot involves the use of explosive drones.

In early November, Iran unveiled a banner that stated 'We Will Kill Trump' over Enqelab Square in central Tehran

Earlier this week, it was reported that Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent became the latest cabinet member moved out of his Washington DC home amid threats on his life from Iran.

The CIA has reportedly been warned by the Mossad that Iran has plotted to assassinate Donald Trump using explosive drones

In early November, Iran unveiled a banner that stated 'We Will Kill Trump' over Enqelab Square in central Tehran

Attorney General Todd Blanche, Pentagon chief Pete Hegseth and Secretary of State Marco Rubio have also been moved to military housing.

As for Trump, he has not held a public event in several days but is set to travel to the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit in China's tech hub of Shenzhen - an unprecedented gathering of the heads of the world's biggest nuclear powers.

There, Trump is slated to hold tri-lateral meetings with Xi Jinping of China and Russia's Vladimir Putin.

The Daily Mail has reached out to the White House for comment on the report of a plot against the President.

The White House said last night that the President is receiving constant updates regarding last night's FAA ground stall.

He has continued to post on his Truth Social Media account throughout this Saturday.

Bessent has been taken to a military base in recent weeks after intelligence determined the threats had reached an advanced stage, The New York Times reported.

It is unclear how serious the threats are...
